notablePrerequisites:
Your life total is five or less.
Paradox Haze attached to you.
description:
At the beginning of your first upkeep, Second Chance, Starfield of Nyx and Paradox Haze triggers.
Resolve the Second Chance trigger, causing you to sacrifice it and take an extra turn after this one.
Resolve the Paradox Haze trigger, causing you to get an additional upkeep step after this one.
Resolve the Starfield of Nyx trigger, returning any enchantment from your graveyard to the battlefield.
At the beginning of your second upkeep, Starfield of Nyx triggers, returning Second Chance from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat each turn.
